The dominant subject is a pale pink fabric bib with a rounded shape, featuring embroidered yellow flowers and green leaves, trimmed with pink piping. Behind it are other bibs: one white with a printed design and a clear plastic pocket, and another dark brown with white polka dots and a green snap button.
